name: gtm
description: Take a GTM Automation workspace from empty to a live outbound campaign in one session. Ships gtm-quickstart (the nine-stage build path incl. the intake interview), outbound-playbook (what to build, with anonymous cross-workspace benchmarks), draft-gtm-play, build-gtm-workflow (incl. the three-table play), sequences (incl. per-channel copy patterns), gtm-handoffs, gtm-operate and a guided setup skill — plus a wired MCP connection to your workspace. Requires a workspace on the Growth plan or higher.

workspace_mcp_key.title: GTM Automation workspace MCP key
workspace_mcp_key.description: Your per-workspace MCP key from the app: Erweiterungen/Extensions -> MCP. Growth plan or higher. Stored in secure storage, never in a plain settings file.
